name: B10-0339/2025 (PPE) – Arbitrary arrest and torture of Belgian-Portuguese researcher Joseph Figueira Martin in the Central African Republic
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the arbitrary arrest and torture of Belgian-Portuguese researcher Joseph Figueira Martin in the Central African Republic
part_text:
The European Parliament is calling for the release of Joseph Figueira Martin, a Belgian-Portuguese researcher held in the Central African Republic since May 2024. He was taken by the Russian Wagner group, tortured, and is still held without trial. The Parliament asks the Central African Republic to free him, let him get medical care, and investigate the torture. It also asks European diplomats to push for his release alongside Belgian and Portuguese authorities. This is an opinion; the text does not change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. The Parliament asks the Central African Republic to release Figueira Martin and allow his medical evacuation.
- **Who it affects:** Figueira Martin, his family, and Belgian and Portuguese authorities working for his release.
- **What happens next:** European diplomats are asked to press for his release. The Parliament also warns of possible European measures if aid workers keep being targeted.
